notes: One entry per kind of creature. The key is its id, used in level files.
name, text: shown to the player. Keep them plain.
kind: dead, beast, myth or rival.
health: how much damage it takes. speed: metres a second. radius, height, wide: its size in metres. deadSize: how much bigger its dead picture is drawn (1 if left out).
sense: 'sight' = it must see you, and sees less far when you are in the dark. 'life' = the dead: light makes no difference.
sight: how far it notices you, in metres. hearing: how far it hears running and fighting.
attack: damage, type (cut, stab or crush), reach in metres, windup = seconds of warning before the blow lands, recover = seconds before it can attack again.
weak: how much of each kind of damage gets through. 1 = normal, 2 = double, 0.5 = half. bare: the same for bare fists (1 if left out).
still + wake: it stands like a statue until you come within 'wake' metres, or hit it.
fleeAt: it runs away once when its health falls below this part (0.35 = 35%).
wade: the deepest water it will walk into, in metres.
xp: experience for killing it (not used yet). drops: [item id, chance 0..1] pairs left when it dies.
look: stand-in picture. shape: biped or beast. colour, eyes: hex colours. detail: wraps or bones. weapon: spear or none.
weak.fire: how badly it burns. 0 = it cannot be set alight; leave it out for 1. A lit torch (weapon with fire:true) sets a creature alight for a few seconds, and it loses health fast while it burns.
boss:true marks a guardian that holds something (the colossus of Ptah guards the gem). detail 'stone' draws a thick, blocky body.
